compiled_state.title: [ticket-create workflow]: tasks created without --parent -> orphaned tasks accumulate in tracker
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 64c36f36a0221d7d2fdb40320ed2637cdd0500e6

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per validate-issues.sh health check semantics, every non-epic ticket (task/story) should have a `parent_id` linking it to an epic. The validator flags orphans as warnings, indicating the workflow contract is: tasks belong to epics. Skills/agents that create tasks (e.g., during /dso:review nitpick consolidation, /dso:fix-bug Phase G anti-pattern scans, /dso:sprint follow-on work, /dso:debug-everything diagnostic captures) should pass `--parent <epic-id>` at creation time, or create a parent epic first.

#### Actual Behavior

`validate-issues.sh` reports 10 orphaned tasks currently in the tracker:

- 0a12-720b — provision-ruleset.sh: document actor_id: 5 = Admin repository role constant
- 2bf0-1eb5 — test-provision-ruleset.sh: add test for check names with JSON-special characters
- 4bca-8c8e — test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh: Test 20 agent-identity inconsistency
- 4cdc-4d77 — provision-ruleset.sh: DEFAULT_BRANCH hardcoded to main
- 6aa7-f220 — ci-dso-staged.yml: DSO_LLM_TIMEOUT_MINUTES not wired
- 7a2b-e866 — provision-ruleset.sh: use jq instead of grep
- 7f86-5c7f — test-ci-llm-review-job.sh: add tier-selection tests
- 9726-9e3f — test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh: 1212 lines, near extraction threshold
- f4b1-239f — Add unit test for reset-cascade-counter.sh
- jira-dig-1573 — Bridge verification test: 44a0-3a13 round-trip

Most originate from review/scan workflows on provision-ruleset.sh and test-ci-llm-review-*.sh, suggesting a specific skill (likely /dso:review nitpick capture or /dso:fix-bug Phase G) is creating tasks without supplying `--parent`. The ticket CLI accepts task creation without `--parent` silently — there is no creation-time guard, so orphans only surface later via validate-issues.sh.

### 3. Action History

User ran `validate-issues.sh`, which reported 10 orphaned tasks (warnings) plus 7 interface tasks needing documentation and 3 in-progress tasks without notes. Total ticket count 332, health score 1/5.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

Suspected sources (based on title patterns):
- `/dso:review` — nitpick consolidation tasks created from reviewer findings
- `/dso:fix-bug` Phase G — anti-pattern scan task creation
- `/dso:sprint` Phase 5 — follow-on task creation when subagents discover scope-adjacent work

Investigation should grep these skills' `ticket create task` invocations for missing `--parent` flags and either: (a) require `--parent` at the CLI level for task type, (b) auto-link to a default "loose-tasks" epic, or (c) update each calling skill to pass `--parent` consistently.
